Using `on:mousemove` to listen to the mousemove event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmousemove` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:mousedown` to listen to the mousedown event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmousedown` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Self-closing HTML tags for non-void elements are ambiguous — use `<progress ...></progress>` rather than `<progress ... />`
https://svelte.dev/e/element_invalid_self_closing_tag

`time` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
